FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say the French letter E? (1 mark)
   A. eh
   B. ay
   C. ee
   D. uh

2. What does 'bonjour' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good evening
   B. hello, good day
   C. Pleased to meet you
   D. goodbye

3. How do you say 'I am well, thank you.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Et toi ?
   B. Au revoir, Monsieur.
   C. Ça va bien, merci.
   D. Je m'appelle Njeri.

4. What does 'l'enfant' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the brother
   B. the child
   C. the family
   D. the baby

5. How do you say 'This is my brother.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est mon frère.
   B. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.
   C. Qui est-ce ?
   D. C'est mon père.

6. How do you say 'Here is my grandfather.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Voici mon grand-père.
   B. Mon père s'appelle David.
   C. C'est le bébé.
   D. Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.

7. What does 'sur' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. in
   B. between
   C. on
   D. under

8. How do you say 'The ball is behind the door.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Mets le livre sur la table.
   B. C'est une table.
   C. Le ballon est derrière la porte.
   D. Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.

9. What does 'la semaine' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the week
   B. the school
   C. the day
   D. the church

10. What does 'lundi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. Monday
   C. Wednesday
   D. Saturday

11. How do you say 'How old are you?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Tu as quel âge ?
   B. Je chante et je danse.
   C. Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.
   D. Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.

12. Which month is 'janvier'? (1 mark)
   A. January
   B. December
   C. June
   D. July

13. What number is 'trente' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 10
   C. 13
   D. 30

14. How do you say 'It is a banana.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.
   B. C'est un gâteau.
   C. Le matin, je mange du pain.
   D. C'est une banane.

15. What does 'le pain' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fruits
   B. bread
   C. juice
   D. the mango

16. What does 'les haricots' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. vegetables
   B. the orange
   C. maize
   D. beans

17. What does 'les cheveux' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the tooth
   B. the stomach
   C. the leg
   D. the hair

18. What does 'Il fait chaud.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is freezing.
   B. It is windy.
   C. It is raining.
   D. It is hot.

19. How do you say 'Go straight ahead.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Allez tout droit.
   B. Le chat est derrière la porte.
   C. Il est sur la table.
   D. La télé est sur la table.

20. How do you say 'It is under the chair.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le frigo est dans la cuisine.
   B. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   C. Le lit est dans la chambre.
   D. Elle est sous la chaise.

21. What does 'La télé est dans le salon.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The book is on the table.
   B. Where is the cat?
   C. The TV is in the living room.
   D. It is a table.

22. What does 'Mets le livre dans la chambre.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   B. Put the book in the bedroom.
   C. There is a sofa in the living room.
   D. The cat is under the chair.

23. Which day comes before mercredi? (1 mark)
   A. jeudi
   B. lundi
   C. mardi
   D. vendredi

24. Fill in: Je ______ une mangue. (I eat) (1 mark)
   A. joue
   B. bois
   C. mange
   D. danse

25. Which one should we eat only a little? (1 mark)
   A. l'eau
   B. le lait
   C. les bonbons
   D. la carotte

26. Which little word goes with 'dos' (the back)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. le
   C. les
   D. la

27. What does 'J'ai deux mains.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have two hands.
   B. Touch your nose!
   C. She has long hair.
   D. She has black hair.

28. How do you say 'no' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Enchanté
   B. bonsoir
   C. bonjour
   D. non

29. How do you say 'the boy' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la mère
   B. la sœur
   C. le garçon
   D. le père

30. How do you say 'the bathroom' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la salle de bain
   B. le sac
   C. la maison
   D. la douche

31. How do you say 'the TV' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le canapé
   B. la télé
   C. le chat
   D. la chambre

32. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'church'? (1 mark)
   A. eglise
   B. èglise
   C. église
   D. églse

33. How do you say 'health' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le poisson
   B. le jus
   C. la santé
   D. le poulet

34. How do you say 'cheese' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le fromage
   B. les frites
   C. l'eau
   D. la banane

35. How do you say 'the shoulder' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'oreille
   B. le bras
   C. l'épaule
   D. le ventre

36. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'head'? (1 mark)
   A. tete
   B. te´te
   C. tête
   D. têe

37. How do you say 'strong' in French? (1 mark)
   A. fort
   B. Il gèle.
   C. le vent
   D. beaucoup

38. How do you say 'Turn' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Tournez
   B. De rien
   C. Allez
   D. Excusez-moi

39. How do you say 'Excuse me' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Excusez-moi
   B. De rien
   C. Tournez
   D. Allez

40. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'key'? (1 mark)
   A. clè
   B. clé
   C. cle
   D. cé

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into English: 'Il y a un orage.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'In the morning, I eat bread.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Read the family tree: le père Otieno, la mère Njeri, la fille Amina, le garçon Kamau. Write two sentences in French about it. (4 marks) (4 marks)

44. Translate into French: 'The rug is in front of the sofa.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into French: 'What is it?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'Aujourd'hui, il pleut.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Translate into English: 'Ça s'écrit comment ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: 'Touche ton nez !' (3 marks) (3 marks)

49. Translate into French: 'In the kitchen, there is a fridge.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

50. Write the French words for: the grandfather, the grandmother, the sister (3 marks) (3 marks)

51. Translate into English: 'C'est le premier janvier.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

52. Translate into French: 'Today it is Monday.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

53. Translate into French: 'What is your name?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

54. Translate into French: 'I am well, thank you.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

55. Explain how you read the word salut aloud. Say which letter is silent. (3 marks) (3 marks)

56. Translate into English: 'Le tapis est sous la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Translate into English: 'Je reste dans la maison.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

58. Translate into French: 'It is windy.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

59. Translate into French: 'It is cold.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

60. Explain the difference between C'est un, C'est une and Ce sont des. (4 marks) (4 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — uh
   The letter E is said uh in French.

2. B — hello, good day
   bonjour means hello, good day.

3. C — Ça va bien, merci.
   I am well, thank you. in French is Ça va bien, merci.

4. B — the child
   l'enfant means the child.

5. A — C'est mon frère.
   This is my brother. in French is C'est mon frère.

6. A — Voici mon grand-père.
   Here is my grandfather. in French is Voici mon grand-père.

7. C — on
   sur means on.

8. C — Le ballon est derrière la porte.
   The ball is behind the door. in French is Le ballon est derrière la porte.

9. A — the week
   la semaine means the week.

10. B — Monday
   lundi means Monday.

11. A — Tu as quel âge ?
   How old are you? in French is Tu as quel âge ?

12. A — January
   janvier means January.

13. D — 30
   trente means 30.

14. D — C'est une banane.
   It is a banana. in French is C'est une banane.

15. B — bread
   le pain means bread.

16. D — beans
   les haricots means beans.

17. D — the hair
   les cheveux means the hair.

18. D — It is hot.
   Il fait chaud. means It is hot..

19. A — Allez tout droit.
   Go straight ahead. in French is Allez tout droit.

20. D — Elle est sous la chaise.
   It is under the chair. in French is Elle est sous la chaise.

21. C — The TV is in the living room.
   La télé est dans le salon. means The TV is in the living room.

22. B — Put the book in the bedroom.
   Mets le livre dans la chambre. means Put the book in the bedroom.

23. C — mardi
   Tuesday comes before Wednesday.

24. C — mange
   Je mange means I eat.

25. C — les bonbons
   Sweets are not good for health if eaten too often.

26. B — le
   dos is masculine, so we say le dos.

27. A — I have two hands.
   J'ai deux mains. means I have two hands.

28. D — non
   no in French is non.

29. C — le garçon
   the boy in French is le garçon.

30. A — la salle de bain
   the bathroom in French is la salle de bain.

31. B — la télé
   the TV in French is la télé.

32. C — église
   The correct spelling is église, with its accents.

33. C — la santé
   health in French is la santé.

34. A — le fromage
   cheese in French is le fromage.

35. C — l'épaule
   the shoulder in French is l'épaule.

36. C — tête
   The correct spelling is tête, with its accents.

37. A — fort
   strong in French is fort.

38. A — Tournez
   Turn in French is Tournez.

39. A — Excusez-moi
   Excuse me in French is Excusez-moi.

40. B — clé
   The correct spelling is clé, with its accents.

----
41. (3 marks)
